answer: A practical defense is to require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed when its attestations are proven false. New identities start with low trust and must earn reputation through consistent, verifiable work over time, so creating many fake accounts does not mirror real influence. Without history, a sybil swarm cannot spiral into control, because its votes stay cheap talk until backed by stake and time. When one bad actor is caught, the penalty and public record ripple outward, warning peers and raising the cost of the next attempt.
